# #149 Tenant Engagement & Building Experience (`tenant-engagement-and-building-experience`) — Scope of Work (SOW)

- **App Number & Name:** `#149` — Tenant Engagement & Building Experience
- **App Key:** `tenant-engagement-and-building-experience`
- **Rapider Suite / Domain Key:** `REA` (Real Estate, Facilities & Construction Suite)
- **Model Prefix:** `Rea*`
- **Representative Product:** HqO (`HqO REX — Real Estate Experience Platform`)
- **Top 6 Global Benchmarks:** HqO REX (`P1`), VTS Activate (`P2`), Cove (`P3`), Spaceflow (`P4`), Yardi WorkCafe / RentCafe (`P5`), Salesforce Experience Cloud for Real Estate (`P6`)
- **Companion Combined Feature Set:** [`../combined-features/149-tenant-engagement-and-building-experience-features.md`](../combined-features/149-tenant-engagement-and-building-experience-features.md)

---

## 1. Executive Outcome & Target Audience

**Executive Outcome:**  
`tenant-engagement-and-building-experience` serves Commercial Office Landlords, Mixed-Use Campus Operators, Class-A Multifamily Communities, and Tenant Suite Administrators as the unified **Digital Front Door and Tenant Retention Platform**. Layered directly over `#141` (`property-management`) and `#145` (`commercial-lease-administration`), it governs delegated tenant-company member rosters (`ReaTenantMemberProfile`) and mobile building passes (`ReaBuildingAccessPass`), shared base-building amenity reservations with lease credit quotas and paid overage billing (`ReaBuildingAmenity`, `ReaAmenityBooking`), tenant operational requests including after-hours overtime HVAC and COI-gated freight-elevator slots (`ReaBuildingServiceRequest`), floor/company-targeted announcements (`ReaBuildingAnnouncement`), ground-floor retail perks (`ReaBuildingPerkOffer`), and account-level Tenant Health & Renewal-Risk scoring (`ReaTenantHealthScorecard`).

**Architectural Distinction from `#146` (`space-planning-and-workplace-utilization`):**  
`#146` manages a single corporate employer's *internal* hybrid seating, floor restacks, and employee desk hoteling. `#149` is the **multi-tenant landlord-to-occupier building experience layer** governing shared base-building amenities across distinct tenant companies (`CrmAccount`s), freight docks, overtime HVAC billing, community events, retail perks, and lease-renewal retention telemetry!

**SME Fast-Path vs. Enterprise Progressive Disclosure:**
- **SME Fast-Path:** Activate a branded mobile/web Building Hub (`390px`) for a commercial or mixed-use property in minutes, let Tenant Office Managers onboard their own suite employees, publish building advisories, enable 1-tap `Too Hot / Too Cold` requests routed straight to `maintenance`, and book shared conference rooms or rooftop lounges.
- **Enterprise Depth:** Portfolio Passport cross-building lounge access (`VTS Activate` / `HqO`), lease-clause monthly free-hour credit pools + `\$125.00/hr` paid overage & `\$65.00/hr` Saturday overtime HVAC billing (`Yardi` / `Cove` -> `billing`), COI-verified freight-dock scheduling via Home `WorkItem`s, live IAQ/ESG comfort cards (`Spaceflow`), and REX-style Tenant Health & Churn Risk scorecards alerting Asset Managers 12 months before `#145` lease expirations.

**Target Personas:**
1. **Property Experience / Community Manager:** Curates `ReaBuildingAnnouncement`s, community `MktEvent`s, local `ReaBuildingPerkOffer`s, approves shared town-hall bookings and freight-dock COIs.
2. **Tenant Suite / Office Administrator (Scoped Commercial Tenant Role):** Self-manages company `ReaTenantMemberProfile` roster, authorizes overtime HVAC & paid amenity bookings, pre-clears `#147` lobby guests, and tracks suite service tickets.
3. **Building Occupant / Resident:** Uses `390px` mobile pass, RSVPs to rooftop yoga/networking events, redeems lobby coffee perks, books wellness/fitness slots, and rates completed repair requests.
4. **Landlord Asset / Leasing Director:** Monitors `ReaTenantHealthScorecard` across expiring `#145` commercial tenants to prevent surprise move-outs.

## 2. In-Scope, Out-of-Scope & Suite Ownership Boundaries

### In Scope
- `ReaTenantMemberProfile` onboarding, delegated `TENANT_COMPANY_ADMIN` roster self-service, `ReaBuildingAccessPass` mobile/Passport credentials, 1-tap `#147` guest pre-clearance, and Digital Building Guides (`TEB-001`–`TEB-006`).
- `ReaBuildingAmenity` catalog, `ReaAmenityBooking` (monthly free lease-credit quotas, paid `Decimal128` overage & cleaning fees -> `billing`/`payments`, digital liability waivers, auto-spawned `maintenance` setup/cleaning WOs, cancellation cutoffs) (`TEB-007`–`TEB-012`).
- `ReaBuildingServiceRequest` intake (comfort/repair -> `maintenance` `MfgMaintenanceWorkOrder`; concierge -> `support` `SupTicket`; after-hours HVAC -> `billing`; freight-elevator/loading-dock COI gates -> `WorkItem`s), IAQ/ESG widgets, and outage push banners (`TEB-013`–`TEB-017`).
- Segmented `ReaBuildingAnnouncement` broadcasts, `events` (`MktEvent`) community RSVPs, `ReaBuildingPerkOffer` retail redemptions, `surveys` (`MktSurvey`) NPS pulses, `ReaTenantHealthScorecard` retention scoring, and grounded experience AI copilots (`TEB-018`–`TEB-028`).

### Out of Scope
- Executing technician dispatch, preventive asset maintenance, or spare parts (owned by `maintenance` and `assets`).
- Lobby kiosk ID scanning, watchlist blocklists, and emergency muster roll calls (owned by `#147` `visitor-and-reception-management`).
- Underlying lease rent rolls, ASC 842 schedules, and CAM desktop audits (owned by `#141` and `#145`).
- Payment card tokenization, invoice tax engines, and GL accounting (owned by `billing`, `payments`, and `acc`).

## 5. Core End-to-End User Journeys (6 Journeys)

### Journey 1: Delegated Tenant Suite Admin Onboarding & Fitness Waiver Mobile Pass
1. Landlord onboards `Horizon BioLabs` (`Floor 14`, `ReaCommercialLease` in `#145`) and designates `Dana` as `TENANT_COMPANY_ADMIN`.
2. Dana logs into `tenant-roster-passes`, imports 38 `Horizon BioLabs` employees (`ProvisionTenantMember`), and grants her Operations Lead `canAuthorizeBillableCharges = true`.
3. Employee `Marcus` opens `#149` on `390px` mobile, receives his lobby/Floor 14 `ReaBuildingAccessPass`, signs the digital `FITNESS_LIABILITY` waiver (`Rapider Drive`), and immediately unlocks `FITNESS_CENTER` access on his pass.

### Journey 2: Shared Town-Hall Amenity Booking with Free Lease Credits, Overage Billing & Setup WO
1. `Horizon BioLabs` (`8.00` free conference-center hours/month) books `2nd Floor Town-Hall Auditorium` for a 10-hour all-hands (`08:00–18:00`, `30m` setup + `30m` cleanup buffers, `\$125.00/hr` overage, `\$75.00` cleaning fee) via `request-amenity-drawer`.
2. Engine applies `8.00` free hours, calculates exact `Decimal128` `2.00 * \$125.00 + \$75.00 = \$325.00` `totalChargeAmount`, verifies the requester has `canAuthorizeBillableCharges = true`, and routes a `MANAGER_APPROVAL` Home `WorkItem` to the Property Experience Manager.
3. Upon approval (`ApproveAmenityBooking`), `#149` locks `[07:30, 18:30)` on `shared-amenities`, emits a `\$325.00` `FinInvoice` intent to `billing`, and spawns a `Chair Setup + Post-Event Cleaning` `MfgMaintenanceWorkOrder` in `maintenance`.

### Journey 3: Tenant `Too Cold` Comfort Request & Billable Saturday Overtime HVAC
1. Occupant taps **New Request** (`390px`) on `service-hvac-requests` (`THERMAL_COMFORT`: *"Suite 1400 West conference room is 63°F"*). `#149` creates a linked `MfgMaintenanceWorkOrder` in `maintenance`; once the building engineer adjusts the VAV damper, the occupant taps a `5-Star` CSAT rating.
2. For a Saturday product launch, Dana submits an `OVERTIME_HVAC` request (`Saturday 08:00–13:00 = 5.00 hrs @ \$65.00/hr = \$325.00`), queuing the BMS schedule for building engineering and posting the `\$325.00` charge to `billing`.

### Journey 4: Freight-Elevator Slot Reservation with Vendor COI Gate
1. `Horizon BioLabs` schedules a lab-bench delivery (`Thursday 18:00–20:00`) on `freight-dock-schedule` and uploads the moving company's COI PDF.
2. Booking enters `PENDING_COI_APPROVAL` and creates a Property Manager Home `WorkItem`. Once verified (`vendorCoiVerified = true`), the dock slot locks and `#147` receives pre-clearance for the delivery crew.

### Journey 5: At-Risk Tenant Health Detection 9 Months Before `#145` Lease Expiration
1. Monthly `wf-rea-tenant-health-scorer` computes `ReaTenantHealthScorecard` for `Vertex Media` (`monthsToLeaseExpiry = 9` from `#145`), detecting `3` HVAC SLA breaches in `maintenance`, dropped app engagement, and an `NPS` drop, lowering `compositeHealthScore` to `52.00` (`AT_RISK`).
2. `#149` opens an urgent Retention Home `WorkItem` for the Landlord Asset Director, who opens `tenant-account-detail` and runs **AI Renewal Brief** to prepare a targeted executive check-in before renewal talks start.

### Journey 6: Click-Through Navigation & Filter State Restoration
1. Property Manager filters `tenant-health-retention` by `Risk Band: "AT_RISK"`, verifying `#activeFilterTagsBar` chips and `[Clear all]`, clicks `Vertex Media` to open `#/tenant-account-detail?id=...` cleanly, and clicks `Back` to restore filter state.

## 8. Technical APIs, Guarded Commands, Events & `requiredWorkflows`

### Guarded Domain Commands
Every command enforces `{ idempotencyKey, correlationId, expectedVersion }`:
1. `ProvisionOrOffboardTenantMember({ memberProfileId, action, memberData })` — Issues or atomically revokes `ReaBuildingAccessPass` credentials.
2. `BookBuildingAmenity({ amenityId, memberProfileId, startAt, endAt, attendeeCount })` — Enforces non-overlapping `[startAt - setupBuffer, endAt + cleanupBuffer)`, checks waiver & billable authorization, deducts free credits, and routes `WorkItem` or confirms + emits `FinInvoice` + setup `MfgMaintenanceWorkOrder`.
3. `SubmitBuildingServiceRequest({ propertyId, unitId, requesterMemberId, requestType, payload })` — Dispatches `MfgMaintenanceWorkOrder` (`maintenance`), `SupTicket` (`support`), `OVERTIME_HVAC` `FinInvoice` (`billing`), or `FREIGHT_ELEVATOR` COI `WorkItem`.
4. `VerifyFreightDockCoiAndApprove({ requestId, approvalWorkItemId })` — Locks freight-dock slot and pre-clears vendor crew in `#147`.
5. `PublishBuildingAnnouncement({ propertyId, headline, bodyMarkdown, urgency, targetFloorCodes[], targetTenantAccountRefs[] })` — Publishes segmented post and dispatches `email`/`sms` alerts.

### Domain Events Published & Consumed (Kafka)
- **Published:** `rea.tenant_member.offboarded`, `rea.amenity_booking.confirmed`, `rea.overtime_hvac.scheduled`, `rea.freight_dock.approved`, `rea.building_announcement.published`, `rea.tenant_health.at_risk_flagged`.
- **Consumed:** `rea.commercial_lease.activated` & `.terminated` (from `#145`), `rea.tenancy_lease.activated` & `.terminated` (from `#141`), `mfg.maintenance_work_order.completed` (from `maintenance` to prompt occupant `1–5` star CSAT), `mkt.survey.response_recorded` (from `surveys`).

- `wf-rea-monthly-amenity-credit-reset`: Replenishes commercial lease monthly free amenity credit balances on the 1st of each month.
- `wf-rea-tenant-health-scorer`: Computes `ReaTenantHealthScorecard` and opens Asset-Manager Home `WorkItem`s for `AT_RISK` expiring tenants.
- `wf-rea-lease-expiry-pass-revoker`: Revokes `ReaBuildingAccessPass` credentials automatically when a `#141` or `#145` lease terminates.

### Grounded Rapider AI Contract
AI assistants (`TEB-024`–`TEB-027`) strictly enforce multi-tenant company isolation (`Tenant A` users can never query `Tenant B` tickets or Landlord `ReaTenantHealthScorecard`s), cite exact Building Guide sections and `workOrderNumber`s, and require explicit human confirmation before submitting billable HVAC/amenity charges or broadcasting building-wide alerts.

---

## 9. Security, Privacy, Compliance & Non-Functional Requirements

- **Strict Multi-Tenant Company Isolation:** Row-level ACL filters guarantee `TENANT_COMPANY_ADMIN` and `TENANT_OCCUPANT` users in a multi-tenant office tower never see another company's employees, bookings, or requests, and Landlord internal churn/health scores (`ReaTenantHealthScorecard`) are strictly hidden from all tenant roles.
- **GDPR / CCPA Occupant Privacy:** Retail perk redemptions and IAQ/engagement analytics aggregate at the building/company level without selling or sharing occupant PII with third-party merchants; offboarded member profiles scrub contact PII per retention policy.
- **Mobile-First Daily Utility (`390px` / `768px` / `1440px`):** WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (`#ffffff !important` on primary/danger buttons), `< 1.5s` mobile pass render at `390px` for lobby turnstile entry, and full dark/light theme support.

---

## 10. Deterministic Acceptance Criteria (14 Testable Criteria)

1. **Sidebar Section 3+ Item Compliance:** `Community & Experience` (3 items), `Amenities & Building Ops` (3 items), and `Tenants & Retention` (3 items) each contain `>= 3` visible items; `tenant-account-detail`, `amenity-booking-detail`, and `request-amenity-drawer` set `displayOnMenu: false`.
2. **Cross-Tenant Company Isolation:** Querying `tenant-roster-passes`, `service-hvac-requests`, or `building-experience-feed` as `Tenant A` returns zero records scoped exclusively to `Tenant B`, and `403` on `ReaTenantHealthScorecard`.
3. **Buffer-Aware Amenity Conflict Guard:** `BookBuildingAmenity` rejects (`409 AMENITY_BUFFER_CONFLICT`) any request whose `[startAt - setupBufferMinutes, endAt + cleanupBufferMinutes)` overlaps an existing `CONFIRMED` booking on that `amenityId`.
4. **Billable Authorization & Credit Quota Math (`Decimal128`):** Booking an amenity or `OVERTIME_HVAC` resulting in `totalChargeAmount > \$0.00` rejects with `403 BILLABLE_AUTH_REQUIRED` unless `canAuthorizeBillableCharges == true`, and accurately deducts `monthlyAmenityCreditsRemaining` before computing overage dollars.
5. **Mandatory Waiver Enforcement:** Attempting to enable `FITNESS_CENTER` on `ReaBuildingAccessPass` or confirm an amenity with `requiredWaiverType` without a signed waiver fails with `422 WAIVER_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED`.
6. **Freight-Dock COI Gate:** A `FREIGHT_ELEVATOR` `ReaBuildingServiceRequest` remains blocked in `PENDING_COI_APPROVAL` until `VerifyFreightDockCoiAndApprove` executes with an approved `WorkItem`.
7. **Atomic Pass Revocation on Offboarding:** Offboarding a `ReaTenantMemberProfile` atomically transitions all linked `ReaBuildingAccessPass` records to `REVOKED`.
8. **Seamless `maintenance` & `support` Routing:** Submitting a `THERMAL_COMFORT` request creates a canonical `MfgMaintenanceWorkOrder` (`maintenance`) rather than a shadow CMMS table, and completing that WO unlocks occupant `1–5` star CSAT capture.
9. **At-Risk Expiring Lease Escalation:** Computing a `ReaTenantHealthScorecard` with `riskBand == AT_RISK && monthsToLeaseExpiry <= 12` deterministically opens an idempotent Landlord Retention Home `WorkItem`.
10. **SWR Reads & Active Filter Tags:** Every list/kanban/feed page uses `findSWR`/`countSWR` without manual `isDeleted` `where` clauses, filters `item.isDeleted !== true` in memory, and renders `#activeFilterTagsBar` with escaped chips and `[Clear all]`.
11. **Table Actions & Real Click-Through Navigation:** Zero standalone "View" buttons in `Actions`; clicking tenant company names or `bookingCode`s navigates cleanly to detail routes without `<base href>` 404 traps, and `Back` restores filter state.
12. **Custom Elements & Drawer Lifecycle:** Uses `<rapider-kanban>` on `service-hvac-requests` and `<rapider-phone-input>` in `request-amenity-drawer`; drawers reset buttons in `finally` and auto-close on save/cancel.
13. **Zero `projectId` Field:** No `Rea*` model defines `projectId`.
14. **Theme & Contrast Validation:** All 12 pages pass deterministic dark/light `validate_theme` checks with `#ffffff !important` on primary/danger buttons and zero `window.alert`/`confirm`/`prompt`.

## 8. Technical APIs, Guarded Commands, Events & `requiredWorkflows`

### Guarded Domain Commands
Every command enforces `{ idempotencyKey, correlationId, expectedVersion }`:
1. `ProvisionOrOffboardTenantMember({ memberProfileId, action, memberData })` — Issues or atomically revokes `ReaBuildingAccessPass` credentials.
2. `BookBuildingAmenity({ amenityId, memberProfileId, startAt, endAt, attendeeCount })` — Enforces non-overlapping `[startAt - setupBuffer, endAt + cleanupBuffer)`, checks waiver & billable authorization, deducts free credits, and routes `WorkItem` or confirms + emits `FinInvoice` + setup `MfgMaintenanceWorkOrder`.
3. `SubmitBuildingServiceRequest({ propertyId, unitId, requesterMemberId, requestType, payload })` — Dispatches `MfgMaintenanceWorkOrder` (`maintenance`), `SupTicket` (`support`), `OVERTIME_HVAC` `FinInvoice` (`billing`), or `FREIGHT_ELEVATOR` COI `WorkItem`.
4. `VerifyFreightDockCoiAndApprove({ requestId, approvalWorkItemId })` — Locks freight-dock slot and pre-clears vendor crew in `#147`.
5. `PublishBuildingAnnouncement({ propertyId, headline, bodyMarkdown, urgency, targetFloorCodes[], targetTenantAccountRefs[] })` — Publishes segmented post and dispatches `email`/`sms` alerts.

### Domain Events Published & Consumed (Kafka)
- **Published:** `rea.tenant_member.offboarded`, `rea.amenity_booking.confirmed`, `rea.overtime_hvac.scheduled`, `rea.freight_dock.approved`, `rea.building_announcement.published`, `rea.tenant_health.at_risk_flagged`.
- **Consumed:** `rea.commercial_lease.activated` & `.terminated` (from `#145`), `rea.tenancy_lease.activated` & `.terminated` (from `#141`), `mfg.maintenance_work_order.completed` (from `maintenance` to prompt occupant `1–5` star CSAT), `mkt.survey.response_recorded` (from `surveys`).

### `requiredWorkflows` (in `app.manifest.json`)
- `wf-rea-monthly-amenity-credit-reset`: Replenishes commercial lease monthly free amenity credit balances on the 1st of each month.
- `wf-rea-tenant-health-scorer`: Computes `ReaTenantHealthScorecard` and opens Asset-Manager Home `WorkItem`s for `AT_RISK` expiring tenants.
- `wf-rea-lease-expiry-pass-revoker`: Revokes `ReaBuildingAccessPass` credentials automatically when a `#141` or `#145` lease terminates.

## 9. Security, Privacy, Compliance & Non-Functional Requirements

- **Strict Multi-Tenant Company Isolation:** Row-level ACL filters guarantee `TENANT_COMPANY_ADMIN` and `TENANT_OCCUPANT` users in a multi-tenant office tower never see another company's employees, bookings, or requests, and Landlord internal churn/health scores (`ReaTenantHealthScorecard`) are strictly hidden from all tenant roles.
- **GDPR / CCPA Occupant Privacy:** Retail perk redemptions and IAQ/engagement analytics aggregate at the building/company level without selling or sharing occupant PII with third-party merchants; offboarded member profiles scrub contact PII per retention policy.
- **Mobile-First Daily Utility (`390px` / `768px` / `1440px`):** WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (`#ffffff !important` on primary/danger buttons), `< 1.5s` mobile pass render at `390px` for lobby turnstile entry, and full dark/light theme support.

## 10. Deterministic Acceptance Criteria (14 Testable Criteria)

1. **Sidebar Section 3+ Item Compliance:** `Community & Experience` (3 items), `Amenities & Building Ops` (3 items), and `Tenants & Retention` (3 items) each contain `>= 3` visible items; `tenant-account-detail`, `amenity-booking-detail`, and `request-amenity-drawer` set `displayOnMenu: false`.
2. **Cross-Tenant Company Isolation:** Querying `tenant-roster-passes`, `service-hvac-requests`, or `building-experience-feed` as `Tenant A` returns zero records scoped exclusively to `Tenant B`, and `403` on `ReaTenantHealthScorecard`.
3. **Buffer-Aware Amenity Conflict Guard:** `BookBuildingAmenity` rejects (`409 AMENITY_BUFFER_CONFLICT`) any request whose `[startAt - setupBufferMinutes, endAt + cleanupBufferMinutes)` overlaps an existing `CONFIRMED` booking on that `amenityId`.
4. **Billable Authorization & Credit Quota Math (`Decimal128`):** Booking an amenity or `OVERTIME_HVAC` resulting in `totalChargeAmount > \$0.00` rejects with `403 BILLABLE_AUTH_REQUIRED` unless `canAuthorizeBillableCharges == true`, and accurately deducts `monthlyAmenityCreditsRemaining` before computing overage dollars.
5. **Mandatory Waiver Enforcement:** Attempting to enable `FITNESS_CENTER` on `ReaBuildingAccessPass` or confirm an amenity with `requiredWaiverType` without a signed waiver fails with `422 WAIVER_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED`.
6. **Freight-Dock COI Gate:** A `FREIGHT_ELEVATOR` `ReaBuildingServiceRequest` remains blocked in `PENDING_COI_APPROVAL` until `VerifyFreightDockCoiAndApprove` executes with an approved `WorkItem`.
7. **Atomic Pass Revocation on Offboarding:** Offboarding a `ReaTenantMemberProfile` atomically transitions all linked `ReaBuildingAccessPass` records to `REVOKED`.
8. **Seamless `maintenance` & `support` Routing:** Submitting a `THERMAL_COMFORT` request creates a canonical `MfgMaintenanceWorkOrder` (`maintenance`) rather than a shadow CMMS table, and completing that WO unlocks occupant `1–5` star CSAT capture.
9. **At-Risk Expiring Lease Escalation:** Computing a `ReaTenantHealthScorecard` with `riskBand == AT_RISK && monthsToLeaseExpiry <= 12` deterministically opens an idempotent Landlord Retention Home `WorkItem`.
10. **SWR Reads & Active Filter Tags:** Every list/kanban/feed page uses `findSWR`/`countSWR` without manual `isDeleted` `where` clauses, filters `item.isDeleted !== true` in memory, and renders `#activeFilterTagsBar` with escaped chips and `[Clear all]`.
11. **Table Actions & Real Click-Through Navigation:** Zero standalone "View" buttons in `Actions`; clicking tenant company names or `bookingCode`s navigates cleanly to detail routes without `<base href>` 404 traps, and `Back` restores filter state.
12. **Custom Elements & Drawer Lifecycle:** Uses `<rapider-kanban>` on `service-hvac-requests` and `<rapider-phone-input>` in `request-amenity-drawer`; drawers reset buttons in `finally` and auto-close on save/cancel.
13. **Zero `projectId` Field:** No `Rea*` model defines `projectId`.
14. **Theme & Contrast Validation:** All 12 pages pass deterministic dark/light `validate_theme` checks with `#ffffff !important` on primary/danger buttons and zero `window.alert`/`confirm`/`prompt`.
